title: Chapter 1203
text:
Somewhere in the Void Dimension, a ray of light flashed, revealing Han Xiao's figure. He had teleported over through the Void Authority.

"Kasuyi should be here. Let's go find him first."

With the Void Authority, a small map of the Void Dimension appeared in his mind. It was very convenient. Han Xiao identified the direction and headed toward the central area of the Void Dimension, which was Kasuyi's territory.

The effect of Void Travel was greatly enhanced here, and he could cross a long distance with every flash. Not long after, Han Xiao arrived at the periphery of Kasuyi's territory. After thinking about it, he stopped outside a crystal floating island that served as a border outpost and released a little bit of his aura.

Rumble!

The surrounding Void Energy stirred up a storm, and the guards in the outpost were alarmed. A huge Void Legion flew out and confronted Han Xiao from a distance. The leader was a Void Duke.

"Who dares to trespass on Lord Kasuyi's … Oh, it's Lord Black Star!"

Before the Void Duke could finish his warning, he saw Han Xiao's appearance clearly and immediately put away his hostility, his attitude becoming friendly.

Han Xiao's reputation in the Void Dimension was not small. The deeds he had left here last time had already spread, and most of the experts at the top of the Void food chain knew about this Void Creature on the same level as Kasuyi. This was due to the influence of the [Void Conqueror] milestone.

"I have an appointment with Kasuyi. Where is he?" Han Xiao asked.

"Lord Kasuyi is already waiting for you in the main hall. Come with me."

The Void Duke dismissed the troops and led Han Xiao into the outpost. They came to a platform engraved with mysterious patterns, then took out a dark blue crystal and activated it with Void Energy. The next moment, the surrounding Void Energy surged and formed a grayish-blue spatial vortex on the ground of the platform.

"A portal unique to Void Technology?" Han Xiao sized it up.

The rules of the Void Dimension were different and had its own technical system. It was a type of method that used the Void Energy as its foundation and made use of its various characteristics. Basically, it could only be effective within the Void Dimension.

As soon as he stepped in, void energy surged through his entire body, making him feel as though he was descending into the clouds. In the next instant, his vision blurred, and he found himself in a majestic and luxurious palace. The palace was made of crystals of various colors, and it was extremely exquisite.

"Black Star, you're here."

A familiar voice came from behind. Han Xiao turned around and saw a small table with Kasuyi sitting on the side and nodding slightly.

Just as he was about to continue speaking, Kasuyi suddenly stopped and revealed a surprised expression.

He suddenly sensed a similar aura from Han Xiao. It wasn't a simple feeling of being of the same race, but rather a very high-level void bloodline.

"You … evolved again?" Kasuyi was surprised.

"No, no, it's just a little bit of progress," Han Xiao said modestly.

As a void creature, it was difficult to hide his Race Evolution from Kasuyi, but the other party could only sense a trace of his aura and couldn't see through his exact situation.

"Every time I see you, you surprise me …" Kasuyi narrowed his eyes and probed, "Just now, was it you who established a connection with the Void Dimension?"

"Oh, you found out." Han Xiao spread out his hands and smiled. "I just tried it. I didn't expect it to be so simple and succeed in one try. I remember you said that you don't mind others connecting to the Void Dimension, so you shouldn't have any objections, right?"

"It's okay, I'm just curious …"

Kasuyi's eyelids twitched, and he waved his hand. He pretended to be indifferent, but his heart was filled with jealousy.

Simple? I f * cking want to beat you to death!

If you can connect to the Void Dimension with a casual try, then what's all the hard work I put in?!

However, he couldn't lose his temper. Being able to do it in one try was his ability, and he couldn't be envious. Comparisons were odious.

While he was cursing in his heart, Han Xiao suddenly stepped forward and pinched his face with his fingers.

Kasuyi was stunned on the spot. He raised his head and stared at Han Xiao.

"W-what are you doing?"

"To see if you're an avatar or your main body." Han Xiao was curious.

"… I'm in my main body now!" Kasuyi slapped away Han Xiao's claws.

Han Xiao was puzzled. "Didn't you say that the dimension you wanted to explore was very dangerous? I thought you would send an avatar, but I didn't expect it to be your main body … With your small body, you still dare to be so reckless?"

Kasuyi's face twitched.

What are you talking about? Do you think I'm fragile?

… Well, compared to you, I'm indeed fragile, but I'm a peak Beyond Grade A after all. No matter how fragile I am, there's a limit.

Kasuyi was speechless for a while before helplessly pointing to the seat opposite him. "Please take a seat and eat something. I'll explain the goal of this trip to you first."

As soon as he said that, a few void creatures carrying trays walked in. The table was filled with food and wine. On the plates were colorful translucent crystals. They were very beautiful.

Han Xiao glanced at the food on the table, and the corner of his mouth twitched.

If he was not wrong, this thing seemed to be the excrement of the Void World Bug, and it was the most essential part …

"What's wrong? Eat some. "

"No, no, my taste isn't that heavy."

Han Xiao hurriedly waved his hands.

This was considered the hometown dish of the void creatures, containing pure void energy. However, he was an acquired species after all, so he did not have such a habit.

Seeing this, Kasuyi did not force him. He picked up the glass and took a sip of wine before explaining the goal of this trip.

"At our current level, God's Trait Transformation is an indispensable path. You must have touched this field. You might not know this, but as the degree of God's Trait Transformation gets higher and higher, there will be a kind of intuition that will allow you to perceive some opportunities for transformation. It may be some objects, or it may be completing some illusory things. As long as you find the opportunity, you can greatly reduce the difficulty of the next God's Trait Transformation.

This time, I sensed an opportunity, and my intuition led me to the secondary dimension we're going to explore later. There seems to be something in there that attracts me and is beneficial to my God's Trait Transformation … "

"Oh?"

Han Xiao's heart skipped a beat.

Transformation opportunity? This was very similar to the prerequisite for the God's Trait Transformation ability to reach level ten.

So this is how it manifests in normal people … Then, Kasuyi definitely has a path of God's Trait Transformation that has reached level ten and above.

To a Beyond Grade A, information regarding the God's Trait Transformation was precious knowledge. Kasuyi was not stingy in sharing it. Han Xiao listened for a while and understood more.

According to Kasuyi, after reaching the high level of God's Trait Transformation, he would sense something similar to a mission. Achieving this mission would allow him to steadily improve his God's Trait Transformation. To explain it in more mysterious terms, it was like seeking one's' path '.

It sounded illusory, but Kasuyi gave two real examples. For example, the mission he sensed was to become the strongest overlord of the Void Dimension, which would be beneficial to his God's Trait Transformation. Manison sensed that he would become the Machinery Faith Main God, and this was what old Manison had told him in private.

Kasuyi also had his own guesses as to why this would happen.

The way he saw it, the God's Trait Transformation was not only the sublimation of an individual but also the entanglement of fate with countless external factors. Only by shouldering and integrating the fate of some groups could the final God's Trait Transformation be completed. It was like a destiny that the strong had to bear.

There's such a thing? Han Xiao was secretly surprised.

Thinking about it, since the God's Trait Transformation had the word 'Divinity', it did not seem impossible. It was just that he did not know what would happen after the transformation was completed.

It was no wonder Kasuyi was so impatient. It turned out that he saw an opportunity to take the next step.

However, from his perspective, this matter could actually be explained simply by the interface. It was probably similar to the requirements of the high level of God's Trait Transformation. It was no longer a rigid indicator of level, ability, attribute, and so on. Instead, it was like some stages of Promotion or Class Advancement, becoming a type of mission that required one to complete something related to the transformation route. Thus, in the eyes of ordinary people, it was like they had sensed their own mission.

Because he had already tested that the Mission Completion Card could take effect on the God's Trait Transformation, although Han Xiao was surprised, he did not feel embarrassed. Instead, he was even happier.

It did not matter how a normal Beyond Grade A cultivated. Anyway, they were not in the same system. He just had to rush it.

At this time, Han Xiao suddenly realized a problem.

"I'm also a void creature, so my transformation route should be the same as yours. According to your theory, won't we become competitors?"

Kasuyi shook his head and said indifferently, "Even if it's the same transformation route, what everyone senses is completely different. Although I don't have much information, my intuition tells me that everyone's path is unique … at least for people of the same generation."

"Then your intuition is really rich." Han Xiao complained and then asked, "I already understand the goal. This time, it's to help you find the opportunity for the God's Trait Transformation in that secondary dimension, right? How's the situation there? Have you explored the path? "

Hearing this, Kasuyi's expression became much more serious. He frowned slightly and said with a deep voice, "I've sent two clones.

"I've already sent my doppelganger there twice. That place is located in the depths of the secondary dimension world. The space turbulence there is extremely violent, and the environment is extremely dangerous. However, this is not the most important thing … there is a group of powerful creatures guarding that dimension. My doppelganger was unable to repel them both times!"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

Being able to repel Kasuyi's clones meant that the total combat power of this group of creatures was comparable to a peak Beyond Grade A. It was undoubtedly a dangerous place in the secondary dimension world, and it was extremely rare. If an ordinary Beyond Grade A encountered it, they would most likely die.

"Have you tried to communicate with them?"

"I tried at the time, but their memories were empty. There was no valuable information, and they seemed to have no self-consciousness. They never responded to me, and I don't recognize what species they are. There are no records in the database."

"Let me see."

Han Xiao frowned, worried that Kasuyi had encountered someone from the World Tree. That would not be good.

However, after seeing the image shared by Kasuyi, Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief. He also did not recognize this creature. He had never seen it in his previous life, so it most likely had nothing to do with the World Tree Civilization.

"Just the guardians outside the secondary dimension have such strength. I wonder what's going on inside. Have you been in?"

"No, I haven't broken through the seal of these creatures, so I don't know what's inside."

"It's already so dangerous outside, so it definitely won't be any better inside. Maybe it's the nest of these creatures …" Han Xiao had a strange expression. "So, you really want to go with your main body? Don't you want to consider it? "

"The opportunity to transform can only be discovered when I go there myself. With your help this time, it shouldn't be a problem. The Mechanic class is most suitable for dealing with large-scale battles. That's your strength."

Kasuyi smiled and said honestly, "I invited you this time.

Not only because of your ability, but also because I want to borrow your King mechanical suit. If the situation isn't good, we can immediately retreat. Only you have such mobility. "

"I see."

Han Xiao nodded, thought about it, and said, "Then, I'll accompany you with my main body.

"Then I'll go with you with my main body. The mechanical body is too fragile. It's not safe."

Hearing this, Kasuyi did not know what expression to make for a moment.

Among all the Mechanics in the universe, only you can say such inhumane words …

Ding!

You have triggered the mission [Kasuyi's Invitation].

Mission Introduction: In order to find an opportunity for the God's Trait Transformation, Kasuyi decided to explore a dangerous and mysterious unknown secondary dimension. Because he saw your ability, he sent you a team request.

Mission Requirements: Help Kasuyi find the target of this trip.

Reward: 450 billion Experience, 6 Random Rewards, 3 Character Summon Cards, + 30 Kasuyi Favorability, 1 God's Trait Transformation Point, Milestone: Unknown

Note: This mission is extremely risky. It is recommended to choose carefully.

"450 billion experience points?!"

Han Xiao's eyes widened, almost suspecting that he had seen wrongly.

The experience reward was often linked to the difficulty of the mission. Killing Old Manison would only give him around 1,000 billion experience. So far, the mission with the highest experience reward he had ever seen was [The End of Darkness], which was basically impossible to complete.

However, this mission actually gave him a reward of 450 billion Experience, and it even specifically said that the difficulty was extremely high?

At this moment, Han Xiao could conclude that there was definitely a huge secret in that mysterious secondary dimension!

In his previous life, there was no such person as himself. Kasuyi's teammate for this trip was most likely Manison. Since the two of them had come out safely, it meant that even if the risk was high, it would not exceed the range of a peak Beyond Grade A's ability.

He had just advanced, and his strength had greatly improved. If Manison and Kasuyi could do it, it should not be a problem for him.

"I've replaced Manison's position. If there's anything good in that secondary dimension, there won't be anything for Manison …"

Thinking about it this way, did he just take away another opportunity from Manison?

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

His greatest hobby now was to persecute Manison, and it felt good to do so.

…

At the same time, somewhere in the Primeval Star River …

"Achoo!"

Manison, who was studying the blueprint, suddenly sneezed, and his face instantly turned gloomy.

With his rich experience, he did not even need to think to know that it was definitely Black Star talking about him again!
